tagline: Dedicated to responsible digitalisation with AI-enabled intelligent solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Generative and predictive AI is positioned as a fundamental pillar of the delivery model, with already operational offerings integrated into strategic platforms (AMPLIO, SOLON TAX), placing Netcompany at the heart of responsible European digital transformation.

kpis.name: AI integration in delivery model
kpis.explanation: Generative and predictive AI is used to automate and enhance decision-making in client solutions, reducing operational costs.
kpis.description: Netcompany affirms that AI is an integral part of its delivery model, with ready-to-deploy solutions in public and financial sectors.
kpis.signal: Generative and predictive AI already integrated into offering and product platforms

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin measures profitability on sales after cost of services.
kpis.description: Gross margin is progressing, reflecting improved efficiency in project delivery and integration of Netcompany Banking Services.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is advancing slightly, reflecting better cost control despite integration of new acquisitions.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: The R&D/revenue ratio is declining slightly thanks to the strategy of reusing existing platforms (AMPLIO, SOLON TAX), while maintaining investment in AI innovation.
kpis.signal: Optimization through platform reuse despite focus on AI innovation

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount is increasing significantly with the completion of the Netcompany Banking Services acquisition on July 1, 2025, consolidating talent in banking services and technology.
kpis.signal: Growth supported by Netcompany Banking Services integration

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to support growth of product platforms.
kpis.description: Capex is rising, aligned with the reusable product platform strategy (AMPLIO for public registries, SOLON TAX for tax and social benefit administrations).
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to support expansion of reusable platforms

kpis.name: AI integration in delivery model
kpis.explanation: Generative and predictive AI is used to automate and enhance decision-making in client solutions.
kpis.description: Netcompany affirms that AI is an integral part of its delivery model, with ready-to-deploy solutions. Concrete example: NBG contract including Data Engineering & AI capabilities, and advanced AI system for field engineering in SEE.
kpis.signal: Generative and predictive AI already integrated into offering and deployed in new contracts

ai_positioning.summary: Netcompany is actively integrating generative and predictive AI into its solutions for public and financial sectors, positioning it as a fundamental pillar of its delivery model. The emphasis is on intelligent automation, enhanced decision-making, and reduction of operational costs.
evidence: AI is a fundamental part of our delivery model
With generative and predictive AI offerings, we have the solutions and are ready to deliver
Leveraging AI enables us to deliver more intelligent, automated solutions that reduce operational costs and improve decision-making capabilities for our customers
